[Section] Experiments ::: Setup
[source_id=40] We evaluate our cross-lingual pre-training based transfer approach against several strong baselines on two public datatsets, Europarl BIBREF31 and MultiUN BIBREF32, which contain multi-parallel evaluation data to assess the zero-shot performance. In all experiments, we use BLEU as the automatic metric for translation evaluation.
